name: Peer into the Abyss
oracle_text: Target player draws cards equal to half the number of cards in their library and loses half their life. Round up each time.
blocked_sentences: Target player draws cards equal to half the number of cards in their library and loses half their life.

needs.what: a value node that halves another value with a rounding direction, e.g. {"half": <value>, "round": "up"|"down"}, so the amount can be half of {"count": {"zone": "library", "player": {"target": "t1"}}} for draw and half of {"life_of": {"target": "t1"}} for lose_life, each rounded up; the library count and life must be read at the moment each instruction is performed (draw first, then life)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has times, sum, minus, min and max but no division or rounding, so ceil(n/2) cannot be built from them; count and life_of can read the library size and life total, and draw/lose_life accept a player and amount, but there is no way to halve the result
